messages:
maria-docs: Heads up — prepping final deprecation notice for v1. Need a short smoke-test checklist + report of any failing snippets.

david-eng: +1. I can run end-to-end snippet smoke tests on staging today. Which PRs are in scope?

maria-docs: All doc PRs referencing /v1/invoke, embed alias names, and any README snippets that call client.v1. Also webhook examples.

sam-sdk: I'll scan the SDK repo for usages of client.v1 or 'redwood/old-embed' and open PRs to update. Quick grep I ran:

sam-sdk: ```bash
grep -R "v1/invoke\\|redwood/old-embed\\|client\\.v1" --line-number || true
```

eli-qa: Can we add a tiny harness that runs the snippets in CI? I can add a job that runs a representative subset — low cost.

maria-docs: Yes please. Add a job named docs/snippet-smoke that runs 5 representative snippets per language. Failing output should be captured to artifacts/docs-snoke/<thread_ts> for triage.

docs-bot: automated note: new job docs/snippet-smoke added to CI by @eli-qa 

david-eng: For streaming examples, ensure we test both chunked and non-chunked flows. I saw a flaky TS streaming snippet last week.

maria-docs: Flagged snippet: streams/ts-chat-stream.md near the top. It uses old streaming signature. I'll push a small PR to update to v2 streaming callbacks.

sam-sdk: One gotcha we hit before: embed dims changed between model variants — verify embedding vector length in examples. Quick check snippet:

sam-sdk: ```js
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-128', input: 'foo' });
console.log(resp.data[0].embedding.length);
```

maria-docs: If length !== 128 mark as fail and file an issue. Add an assert in the CI harness.

eli-qa: Also ensure deprecation banner copy is consistent across /docs and /console. I drafted a short blurb in the PR description.

maria-docs: Draft copy: "v1 of the Redwood API will be retired on 2026-05-15. Please migrate to v2 — see the migration guide at /docs/migrate-v2. Contact support for enterprise migrations." Open to edits.

david-eng: Can we include automatic redirects for old links? Web team can 302 /v1/* => /docs/migrate-v2 to avoid broken bookmarks.

maria-docs: Filing web ticket now and will attach ticket number to the PR.

sam-sdk: I'll also add a brief deprecation note in the SDK CHANGELOG and emit a console.warn from the v1 shim indicating retirement date. That should nudge users.

maria-docs: Owners: docs PRs — @maria-docs; SDK PRs — @sam-sdk; CI job — @eli-qa; web redirects — @david-eng.

maria-docs: Timeline: tests run today, fix PRs merged by EOD Friday, announcement early next week.

david-eng: LGTM. If any of the smoke tests uncover infra-related failures (timeouts, kernel crashes), ping eng-runtime immediately.

maria-docs: Agreed. Please flag performance vs correctness — we only want to block on correctness issues for the deprecation announcement.

eli-qa: I'll start the CI job and post results here when finished.

maria-docs: Thanks all :rocket:
